findings.title: apply_discount raises TypeError when rate is None
findings.body_markdown:
`apply_discount` used to return the price unchanged when `rate` was `None`; this PR removes that guard and computes `price * (1 - rate)` directly.

`Promotion.rate` is documented as `None` for a code that carries no discount, and `CheckoutSession.discounted_total` now passes it through untouched, so a free-shipping promotion raises `TypeError: unsupported operand type(s) for -: 'int' and 'NoneType'` on the checkout path.

findings.title: discounted_total no longer defaults a missing promotion rate
findings.body_markdown: The local `rate = promo.rate if promo.rate is not None else 0.0` default was removed on the assumption that the promotion service normalises rates. Nothing in this diff enforces that assumption at the boundary.
findings.repro_hint: drive discounted_total with a promotion whose rate is None
